next_edition.label: Makers Market 4.0 (March expected from the October and March pattern)

audience.psychographics: Design lovers who value originality, independent practice and small-batch contemporary making: jewellery, ceramics, textiles, object-making, art and design-led homewares.

add_sources.note: IG bio: 'A weekend market style design event held at the @goodform_design gallery'. Eventfinda calls it 'the next evolution of Good Form's bi-annual platform' (https://www.eventfinda.co.nz/2026/makers-market/auckland/eden-terrace, Google snippet).

Google snippet: inaugural Makers Market 11 to 12 Oct 2025. Edition 2.0 was 28 to 29 Mar 2026 (https://www.goodform.co.nz/our-journal/makers-market-edition-2-0-march-28-29, Google snippet); 3.0 was 10 to 11 Oct 2026. March 2027 inferred from that pattern, not announced.
'As a bi-annual event, each edition is carefully composed ...' (editions run in March and October).
About page: 'For those who value originality, independent practice and meaningful making'; disciplines listed.

add_gaps: No sponsors found; event is run by Good Form gallery

notes: Small, gallery-run curated design market (about 20 creatives at Edition 2.0 per https://www.instagram.com/p/DWa7FnSEulS/) held twice a year at Good Form, Eden Terrace. No sponsors; IG mentions are makers and photographers. Next edition date is an inference from the March and October pattern.
